summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its subsidiary, Banco Inter S.A., issued R$300 million in subordinated financial bills (LFSN) to professional investors. The bills qualify as Additional Capital under Brazilian Central Bank regulations, with an estimated 0.6 percentage point impact on Banco Inter's Basel Ratio. The notes are redeemable from July 2031, subject to regulatory approval. This is a capital management transaction, not a special situation—there is no change of control, restructuring, or strategic review. Watch for future regulatory approvals and Basel Ratio updates.
